prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Goal: A production reference for ONE attractive building model for a ROBLOX mining simulator game. Explicit visual style: modern Roblox, Mining Simulator 2, polished colorful Roblox simulator architecture.
Subject: A large square OPEN-SIDED MINE PAVILION, with a COMPLETE SOLID PITCHED GABLE ROOF covering the ENTIRE footprint. Broad fresh forest-green roof panels with chunky lighter green ridges and thick honey-oak eaves. Roof ridge runs front to back. Wide triangular front gable has a clean wooden border and open air below it. Six substantial square warm honey-oak posts on low simple cream sandstone square footings support the roof, all posts around the perimeter only. Two stout diagonal oak braces below each side roof beam. Low waist-high timber rails along sides and rear, with the ENTIRE FRONT open for walking in. Two small warm golden lanterns hang near the front corner posts.
Proportions: Outside roof footprint about 26m wide and 26m deep. Ridge height about 13m, eave height 8m. Clear square inner opening at ground level at least 18m wide and deep. Tall posts are relatively slender, about 1m thick, positioned near outer corners; no interior columns. It shelters a 16m square mining pit, but DO NOT draw the pit, floor, or any ground in this isolated asset reference. Central space under roof is EMPTY and unobstructed. No machinery, no carts, no ore, no furniture, no characters.
Materials and style: Bright clean stylized ROBLOX game building, chunky readable silhouette, restrained soft bevels on solid square timbers, simple broad clean wood grain, saturated natural green roof, warm golden wood, cream stone bases, dark iron bolt accents. Strong simple color blocks. Matte, cheerful daylight. Gentle stylized gradients; no noisy photorealistic texture.
Camera: Three-quarter FRONT view at modest elevation so the full roof is visible AND the tall open entrance and empty interior are clearly readable. Entire building including all roof corners and all post feet fully in frame with margin. Plain light grey studio background visible through the open interior.
Constraints: COMPLETE ROOF is mandatory, front entrance wide open. NO FLOOR, NO BASE PLATFORM, NO ground plane attached to model. No walls closing the front. No central supports. No stone arches. No ruin, no medieval fortress, no World of Warcraft fantasy style, no realistic weathering, no dark gritty materials, no stone rubble, no moss-covered masonry. No text, logos or UI.
